deploy_destination.evidence: Reported by Codex (authenticated real browser, 2026-10-21/22): production frontend commit 2a4086a037ea241ef0cc602b55d9913c895a4b39, apps/create/page.tsx reads `github`; @fromRepo/lib/getInitialState.ts initializes the source. https://wasmer.io/apps/create?github=satnaing%2Fastro-paper showed 'Configure your app', 'Importing from GitHub satnaing/astro-paper', branch main, preset node-static, Deploy enabled. No deployment was submitted.
deploy_destination.why_not_verified_by_claude: This cloud sandbox's egress policy denies wasmer.io, docs.wasmer.io and registry.wasmer.io (proxy 403 / DNS ENOTFOUND).
deploy_destination.semantics: Imports the public source repository for detection and build. It does not copy the repository into the visitor's GitHub account; redeploy-on-push needs the visitor's own repository connected. README copy therefore tells users to import their own fork/template copy to customize.
